translator.agent: i18n-translator (as named by the requesting manager)

findings.current: Открывает текущую работу, задачи и субагентов
findings.problem: The source names a UI surface — «the working line» — and the hint renders it as an abstraction, «current work», which has no referent a screen-reader user can find on the screen. The other three shipped locales keep the surface: fr «la ligne d'activité», es «la línea de trabajo», zh-CN «工作状态行».
findings.replacement: Открывает строку текущей работы, задачи и субагентов
findings.gating: MINOR — does not block shipment on its own; the other 1 key in this namespace is clean.

considered_and_accepted.judgement: ACCEPT, and it carries a cross-key requirement.
considered_and_accepted.reason: Byte-identical to the citation inside mobile.home.options.fixed (…в разделе «Детали беседы»), which the sidecar requires: the destination screen's title must match wherever it is named. A future edit to either string must move both.

notes: mobile.session has 2 keys and no placeholder or plural node; verify.mjs ran 21 checks on it.

route.engine: the repository's own renderer: messages.parseMessage + messages.formatMessage + messages.pluralCategory (the same functions renderFor calls)
route.render_entry_point: renderFor(key, args, "ru") returns the ENGLISH source at this head, because ru is still in NOT_YET_SHIPPED_LOCALES (proved in audit.log of ru30a1 via appendix-composition.txt); every ru string in these records was therefore rendered by calling formatMessage(parseMessage(<ru value>), args, "ru") directly, which is byte-identically what renderFor does once ru ships — proved by rendering all 38 zh-CN mobile.schedules keys through both paths and getting identical output.
route.width_engine: swift + CoreText over the app's sans stack (measure.swift.txt); Figtree absent on this machine, so widths use the system face — the harness reproduces the repo's recorded 189.4 pt Spanish chip measurement, which is why ratios are used for judgement
route.machine_translation: none — no translation or MT service was used to compare or back-translate
route.read_only: the working tree was not edited, staged, committed or pushed; the only writes are these audit bundles under i18n/audits/evidence/ru/

ledger.note: No audit-ledger command and no i18n ledger exist in this repository at this head (i18n/ holds only audits/, and scripts/i18n/ has check-strings, generate, key-shape, ratchet, scan-strings — no ledger writer). The served record is this record.json under i18n/audits/evidence/<locale>/<namespace>/<id>/, matching the fr, es and zh-CN waves' machinery. There is likewise no i18n/audits/evidence/README.md contract in this checkout.

audit_notes_not_execution_log: This record and report.md are NOTES. The execution evidence is audit.log in the same directory: a bash set -x transcript of the catalogue validator, verify.mjs for this namespace, and verify.mjs --negative, captured when they ran. widths.tsv / tip-overflow.txt / widths-placeholder.tsv / appendix-composition.txt are measurement and composition artifacts, produced by the harnesses also stored here.
evidence_limitations: Figtree is not installed on this machine, so CoreText widths use the system sans face; absolute points are approximate and the report leans on ratios and on the headroom each row records. The harness reproduces the repository's own recorded 189.4 pt Spanish-chip measurement, which is the calibration check.

renderFor(key, args, "ru") cannot render this catalogue yet — ru is still in NOT_YET_SHIPPED_LOCALES — so renders come from formatMessage(parseMessage(<ru value>), args, "ru"), proved byte-equal to renderFor on the 38 zh-CN mobile.schedules keys.
No rendered frame was captured: this was a copy audit, and the app was not built or driven. A UI reviewer still has to look at the ru strings in a build.

The 320 pt field width for ended_placeholder is derived from the sidecar's own 390 pt measurement (~348 pt) minus the viewport difference; it is an inference from a recorded measurement, not a direct capture.

Plural and placeholder machinery was exercised on the whole ru catalogue (11 plural nodes, all carrying one/few/many/other with correct numeral-noun agreement) but this namespace contains none of them.
